# Nix Workshop v0.10.3

This release fixes the four concrete boundaries exposed by live run `1da211aab7c2` without changing Hive's authority or retry budgets.

- Existing-interface coverage now allows a statically verified provider contract to remain no-change and sends redundant backend assignments through the existing single planner correction.
- Test workers receive bounded, read-only examples of real repository-local endpoint and frontend/static test patterns.
- Targeted correction records the failed edit signature and rejects an effectively identical replacement as `RepeatedFailedProposal`.
- Runtime retrieval evaluates exclusions relative to its logical root, so private staged pytest paths beneath an outer `hive_runs` directory remain searchable while inner runtime subtrees stay excluded.
- Job polling now reports host-known planning, worker, verification, review, and terminal stages, with atomic terminal result publication and stale-update protection.
- Local/cloud model routing, output ceilings, timeouts, retry budgets, validation, staging, review, approval/apply, rollback, and cloud budget controls are unchanged.
